subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear Customer, We are pleased to inform you that your flight booking from New York to Los Angeles on May 15th has been successfully confirmed. Your booking reference number is XYZ123. Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before departure for a smooth check-in process. Should you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact our customer support team. We look forward to welcoming you on board! Safe travels.
